items.title: SSRF — http.NewRequest with variable URL
items.remediation: Validate the URL before building the request. The standard pattern: `u, err := url.Parse(target); if err != nil || !allowlist[u.Host] { return forbidden }`. Reject schemes other than http/https up front.
